answer_1.quote: In this paper, we explore whether we can leverage the generation ability of the state-of-the-art LMs, to generate augmented samples for a given target class.
answer_1.outputs: augmented text samples for classification tasks

answer_2.quote: We use perplexity (PPL) as an auxiliary metric to evaluate the augmentation quality.

answer_4.quote: We conducted human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) in May 2020. Participants (N = 178) were randomly assigned to evaluate one of the three tasks...
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to answer a series of questions about label agreement (e.g., 'How much do you agree with the assigned class label?' on a 7-point scale) and to rate the readability of samples on a 7-point scale. The readability measure included five items: well-written, concise, comprehensive, coherent, and clear.
